card.name: Text just before a hyphen in dose labels
card.fires_on: The last piece of a label or number right before a hyphen and a short following part, such as the 2 in 2-mg, the P in P-gp, or the a in 130a-c.

modes.label: Dose strengths before -mg
modes.description: A digit in a strength like 2-mg, 5-mg or 50-mg/mL, right before the hyphen.

modes.label: Letter before hyphen in a name
modes.description: A single letter or short piece that begins a hyphenated term such as P-gp, or a list item like 130a-c.

modes.label: File or code names
modes.description: Pieces of file or label identifiers just before a hyphen or underscore.

card.writes: It favors a short single-letter piece after the hyphen or underscore and disfavors longer word continuations like figure or release.
card.plain: It fires on the bit of a term just before a hyphen, such as the number in 5-mg or the P in P-gp.
